Found during the P7.2 representation migration, 2026-08-03. AgentDomainJson defines BOTH a derived codec for ScriptSource (private given Encoder/Decoder[ScriptSource] = deriveEncoder/deriveDecoder) and a hand-written one that encodes Inline as {"kind":"inline","name":...,"bytesBase64":...}. The derived pair is what field[ScriptSource](cursor, "source") uses.

The two disagree on how bytes are represented: the hand-written path is base64, the derived path is circe generic, which renders bytes as a JSON array of numbers. The migration made this visible because deriveEncoder could no longer find an instance once bytes stopped being Vector[Byte]; circe had been supplying it silently.

I preserved the array-of-numbers shape with an explicit Encoder/Decoder[ByteVector] so no wire format changed. That is a deliberate hold, not an endorsement: choosing one representation for ScriptSource bytes is a wire-format decision and belongs here or in P6f.12, not in a representation swap. Whoever takes it should also check whether the derived and hand-written paths are ever used for the same field, because if so one of them is already wrong.
